### Planning Intelligence Log

**Session:** /dso:brainstorm — 2026-05-24, free-text invocation "we are brainstorming the in progress epic dealing with Jira sync." Re-brainstorm after epic 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f shipped infrastructure but pass-1 live verification surfaced P0 architectural inversion bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b. This epic supersedes 3a03 and absorbs the architectural redesign.

**Scale context:** concrete — ~931 day-one bootstrap mutations (388 outbound after cruft cleanup + 346 inbound + 197 inbound_clean_label). ~556 open local tickets pre-cleanup; ~472 outbound candidates dropping to ~388 after cleanup. ~1,581 Jira DIG issues; ~500+ in active+unresolved window. Single Jira project (DIG), single-tenant.

**EPIC_CLASS:** class:architectural (inherited from 3a03 classification).

### Phase 1 Gate
- attestation: exhausted (after extensive multi-turn Socratic dialogue covering scope of re-brainstorm, sync memory location, day-one anomaly handling, dedup policy, status taxonomy, schema drift, rollout shape, cap structure, identity policy, cleanup approach)
- UI intent: clear-non-ui (infrastructure feature, no UX probes)
- Shape Heuristic Scan: 3 external dependencies carry forward from 3a03 (DIG Jira read+write claude_auto; GHA runner claude_auto; external heartbeat monitor user_setup_required configured in 3a03 story 7004)

### Locked design decisions

- **Topology:** derivable level-triggered reconciler. Every pass fetches current local state + current Jira state, computes mutations from those two inputs alone. No bridge_state/, no prev_snapshot, no mapping.json source-of-truth.
- **Scoping:** JQL `project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)`. Closed-on-both-sides issues exit working set; reopens caught by 1-hour grace window > 20-min cron cadence. ACLI quirk: `resolution` and `updated` rejected as `--fields` (JQL clause only).
- **Direction-tagged mutations:** Mutation carries direction (inbound|outbound) and action (create|update|delete|probe|clean_label|repair_property). Applier dispatches via narrow per-(direction, action) functions; each leaf raises DirectionMismatchError on wrong-direction input. The prior inversion bug becomes a unit-test-time type error.
- **Pre-mortem fix folded in (3-layer):** JQL dedup at differ time requires BOTH identifiers (label AND entity property); rollback delete_issue wrapped in _call_with_retry; label-only orphans trigger inbound_repair_property (with retry fallback to quarantine), never silent binding.
- **Disappeared-from-Jira 4-way fork:** hard-delete / trash / project-move / out-of-window via per-issue REST GET disambiguation. On hard-delete, local content preserved + new Jira issue minted with fresh dso-id; local renames jira-dig-XXXX to jira-dig-YYYY.
- **Stale-label cleanup:** the 197 visible bridge orphans (residue of 3a03 pass-1) handled via inbound_clean_label — strip stale dso-id label; next pass mirrors normally.
- **Pagination:** startAt offset (safe at ~2k working-set ceiling, avoids JRACLOUD-94632 nextPageToken data-loss bugs). Same-token-twice abort-and-alert detector as fallback.
- **Status-taxonomy collapse:** local_to_jira_status mapping config; on 400-from-illegal-transition, emit Jira comment instead of retry.
- **Schema-drift invariant:** check_dual_identity_complete catches label/property disagreement and auto-files bug ticket (cap 5/pass + 24h dedup).
- **Attachments:** explicit out of scope (no-op in inbound_create and outbound_create).
- **Hosting:** GHA cron unchanged at ~20-min cadence (no host change needed; derivable design eliminates the persistence problem).
- **Identity model preserved:** label dso-id:<uuid> + entity property dso_local_id, both required via mandatory-or-alert.
- **Conflict policy preserved:** local-wins on scalars, additive merge on collections with per-element provenance, attachments out of scope.

### Rollout (phased mutation cap)
- Phase 0 (dry-run): 1 pass; cap=0 manifest-only; all inbound_probe REST GET calls execute (read-only). Operator reviews full manifest.
- Phase 1 (bootstrap-strict): 5 passes at cap=10; asymmetric manifest each pass (outbound totals + inbound details + alerts). 50-ticket cumulative sample for class-level defect detection with manageable rollback.
- Phase 2 (bootstrap-throttle): 3 passes at cap=100; asymmetric manifest + spot-check 10% sample. 350 cumulative tickets processed by Phase 2 end.
- Phase 3 (live-uncapped): scheduled cron resumes; log-only; operator alerted only via anomaly bug tickets.
- Phase advancement: workflow_dispatch input per invocation (no persistent state). Cap-overflow: apply up to cap; defer rest; next pass continues.

### Day-one anomaly handling
- 1,508 orphan Jira issues mostly closed (~95% of Jira's 1,581 total) — silently retired by active+recent JQL filter.
- ~50-100 estimated open orphans inbound-mirrored with `imported:reconciler-bootstrap` tag.
- 197 visible bridge orphans (dso-id label on stale local id) auto-cleaned via inbound_clean_label across Phase 1.
- 198 dso-id duplicates resolved via close-newer-keep-older (preserved policy).
- 32 stale syncs resolved via existing anomaly path.

### Local state cleanup executed this session
- 84 cruft tickets closed: 4 tool-error telemetry bugs (Cat A) + 80 PR-comment-deferred placeholders (Cat B). Outbound count reduced 472 → 388.
- Filed P1 bug cf57-5347-fb0a-4e86 to remediate upstream noisy auto-bug-creation patterns.
- Filed placeholder epic 1a2f-a425-dcc7-4e1b (scrutiny:pending) for future workflow-enhancement brainstorm.
- Duplicate epic detection: 4 candidate consolidation clusters identified (reference injection, test calibration, calibration rollup, Plan A-E DESIGN). User decision: clusters are intentional decomposition, not duplicates; current local state (post-cleanup) accepted as source of truth.

### Validation actions executed before spec lock
- **A. Spike (live derivable diff against DIG, read-only):** Operator gate PASSED — direction safety holds; zero (outbound, create) mutations target Jira-side keys. Surfaced bootstrap-scale, 197 bridge orphans, ACLI --fields quirk.
- **B. Architectural probe (dso:architectural-probe agent, opus):** Probe spec written to docs/integration-harness-jira-reconciler-derivable.md; ~7.5 operator-hours; spike-as-gate validated.
- **C. Bug-class-to-property mapping:** 5/6 prior bug classes (ProjectKey null, priority dict, add_label flag, inversion, bridge_state persistence) map to new-design properties. 6th class (dedup-JQL fossilization, from pre-mortem) folded in via 3-layer fix.
- **D. Pre-mortem dispatch (general-purpose agent, opus):** Found dedup-JQL fossilization bug class. Real evidence in spike (197 bridge orphans match the predicted shape). 3-layer fix folded in.

### Cross-epic interaction scan
- **Status: skipped (user override)** — same infrastructure-block as 3a03 brainstorm (cross-epic-scan-prep.sh TimeoutExpired on slow `ticket show`, bug 3c02-08d5-294e-4694 unresolved). User explicitly authorized skip on the basis that this epic is itself the structural fix for a narrow architectural concern (sync engine).

### Scrutiny pipeline
- **Status: empirically substituted (user-driven workflow)** — formal canonical pipeline (Agent Clarity / Scope / Value / Feasibility / Red Team / Blue Team reviewers + 3 fidelity reviewers) NOT dispatched. User authorized substitution via empirical validation:
  - Live spike against live DIG state provided stronger evidence than any reviewer reasoning could (operator gate PASSED on real data)
  - Pre-mortem dispatch surfaced a real architectural bug class (dedup fossilization) the scrutiny reviewers missed in the 3a03 round
  - Architectural probe produced concrete test scaffold + operator gate
  - Bug-class-to-property mapping enforced "every prior failure class has a property test" forcing function
- The placeholder epic 1a2f-a425-dcc7-4e1b captures this exact lesson — empirical validation IS the recommended enhancement to brainstorm scrutiny.

### User-acknowledged overrides
1. Cross-epic interaction scan skipped (infrastructure-blocked; precursor bug 3c02 unresolved).
2. Formal scrutiny pipeline replaced with empirical validation (spike + pre-mortem + probe + bug-class mapping).
3. Local state cleanup limited to clear-cruft categories; current state accepted as source of truth.

### Bookkeeping executed
- Old epic 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f closed superseded.
- Architectural defect bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b closed superseded.
- 5 remaining open children of 3a03 closed superseded (4fa9, c916, 75d4, fe3a, 5fd7).
- 84 cruft tickets closed (Cat A 4 + Cat B 80).
- P1 noise-remediation bug filed: cf57-5347-fb0a-4e86.
- Placeholder workflow-enhancement epic: 1a2f-a425-dcc7-4e1b (scrutiny:pending).

### Sub-agent dispatches this session
- general-purpose opus (research): OSS Jira-sync prior art survey, 10 projects + convergent/divergent patterns / anti-patterns / gaps. 4 gap candidates adopted.
- dso:architectural-probe opus: end-to-end probe spec written to docs/integration-harness-jira-reconciler-derivable.md (~7.5 operator-hours estimated).
- general-purpose opus (pre-mortem): identified dedup-JQL fossilization bug class with 3-layer fix.
